title: Start an OpenHands server via Docker when present
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. If Docker is installed and no OpenHands server is reachable, offer to run the supported image with the right ports and API key wiring. Tests zc_openhands_docker_* with a fake docker.
